lines.say: Your city gave every resident a free phone. You just found out why.
No bills. No ads. Best phone you ever had.
Then a new show comes out. Every TV in the tower is watching it.
It's your kitchen. Your voice. Last night's fight with your mom. Episode one.
It is the number one show in the city. Season two starts tonight.
Would you keep the free phone? Write it in the comments.
